responsibility: Implements a socket-backed channel device that plugs client TCP connections into the generic gm2 ISO channel framework. It allocates a device id, attaches per-channel client socket state through RTdata, maps channel operations onto read/write/close and wrapsock helpers, installs generic text/raw accessors through RTgen/RTgenif, reports errno-derived open and device errors, and thus produces ChanId streams that IOChan-based modules can treat like ordinary devices.
same_name_distinction: This file provides the concrete client-socket device implementation: unlike ClientSocket.def, it allocates the device id, stores socket state via RTdata, hooks generic channel callbacks, and maps channel operations onto wrapsock/libc socket I/O.
